[2026-09-01T20:47:44.521Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further east — 5 tiles, about 13 hours of travel.
[2026-09-01T20:47:44.522Z] [world] A young Reclaimer kneels at the edge of the road, hands cupped around something that is not in their hands. Their breath comes in counted intervals — they are trying not to be a problem. Around them the air is striped with thin sparks that connect nothing to nothing. Latent Power, breaking through. The Eternal Dynasty would call this a recruitment. The Mud Monarc
hs would call it a problem to be erased.
[2026-09-01T20:47:44.522Z] [arbiter] The Reclaimer's mouth moves out of sync with their voice. 'It's like a name I almost remember. It hurts to almost remember.'
[2026-09-01T20:47:44.523Z] [world] By the time you have decided whether to help, the sparks have closed back into the Reclaimer's chest and left them shaking. They will be different by morning. They do not yet know in what direction.
[2026-09-01T20:47:44.532Z] [world] The thought you set down here is right where you set it down.

[2026-09-01T20:48:35.116Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further east — 2 tiles, about 5 hours of travel.
[2026-09-01T20:48:35.117Z] [world] A church steeple breaks the mud at a sideways angle — the rest of the building swallowed whole. The steeple's broken door yawns open and lets you down into what used to be the choir balcony. Inside the air is dry, dimmer than outside, and the pews below the mudline are still arranged for a service that never ended. A pre-flood reliquary lies overturned on the alt
ar. You pick through what the flood spared.
[2026-09-01T20:48:35.117Z] [world] A burned ledger names every Tartarian who took shelter here when the flood came. The last entry is in a child's handwriting: 'we are still inside. someone knock on the steeple if you find us.'
[2026-09-01T20:48:35.118Z] [reward] ✦ Recovered Worn Tartarian Coin x5.
[2026-09-01T20:48:35.128Z] [world] Whatever clock this place runs on, it has not ticked since you left.
